prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: replacement pixel-art WALK sprite sheet for Elowen's Last Stand. Image 1 is exact character/style reference, NOT a motion reference: its legs are defective and must be redrawn. Create a COMPLETE EIGHT-POSE WALK-IN-PLACE CYCLE, 4 columns x 2 rows, read left to right then top to bottom. Transparent alpha background. Each cell same size, all eight whole figures face screen RIGHT, strict side-view legs. Preserve this adult female elf's identity: golden blonde long hair, pointed ears, blue jewels, silver armour with gold trim, navy blue/gold cloak/tabard, full-length steel sword held low forward in near hand, large blue/gold kite shield in far hand. Match intricate crisp pixel-art style and adult proportions. Do NOT shorten sword. Fixed pelvis horizontal position and consistent body size. Show both boots and knee joints clearly; cloak opens around legs so it never hides the gait. The essential requested correction: legs actually CROSS and SWAP front/back positions across a full two-step stride. Near leg slightly brighter silver, far leg slightly darker silver, keep that identity for entire cycle. Pose 1: NEAR leg extended FORWARD heel planted at right, FAR leg extended BACK toe touching at left. Pose 2: near leg takes weight bends slightly, far heel lifts behind. Pose 3: PASSING: near leg supports vertically UNDER hip; FAR knee bent swings FORWARD across the near shin, far foot visibly lifted. Pose 4: far knee leads forward and lower leg extends to land, near leg pushes off behind. Pose 5: OPPOSITE CONTACT: FAR leg extended FORWARD heel planted at right, NEAR leg extended BACK toe touching at left. This must visibly swap which leg is in front compared with pose1. Pose 6: far supporting leg bends slightly, near heel lifts behind. Pose 7: opposite PASSING: far leg supports vertically under hip, NEAR knee bends and swings FORWARD across it, near boot lifted. Pose 8: near knee reaches forward to start pose1, far leg pushes back. One foot always touches same ground baseline, no hopping, no running, no shuffling feet permanently wide apart. Subtle natural head bob and delayed cloak/hair sway; shield and sword stable with restrained counter movement. Exactly two legs, no double limbs. Entire equipment within each cell with transparent margins, aligned feet, consistent body height. No labels, no grid, no scenery, no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no glow. A smooth confident Castlevania-like side scrolling stride using original Elowen artwork. Crucially poses3 and7 have crossed legs with the swinging bent-knee boot airborne; poses1 and5 exchange leading legs.
